context:
Goal: main green and merges flowing.
Problem (rule): main is red because #3564 (the pin, which you merged yourself at 19:23 CST) landed without the two test edits it needed. Rule git-red-main-reverts lets only the revert of the blamed commit merge, so a fix that is not a revert needs your word on that exact PR.
Based on (read): failed job logs of run 43785958800 at c9f481c36: test_checks_stays_a_required_check_and_mods_adds_no_name ("'checks-rest' not found in ['all-jobs-passed']") and test_main_stamp_reads_required_checks_from_protection ("['all-jobs-passed'] != 'protection'"). #3567 (head cf072553bcd63ec5bbb845c107ca855fff27e9dd, tests only) re-points exactly those two; runner 10's lane lint PASS at that head (comment 6905784954); review record 6905536984; newest main runs 43785958800 and 43786153106 both failed. (Coordinator's read, unread by triage.)
Departs from: main — only the blamed commit's revert merges while main is red — #3567 merges first as a fix-forward.
Why asked: the consultant asked you in chat at 20:08, 20:17, 20:20 and 20:22 CST and has no typed answer. The recommendation is the coordinator's, not typed by you. The grant covers only the act the chosen option names.
ANSWER (chat, relayed): option a "Yes, #3567 only, on red main", note "yes merge of course", owner chat 21:01 CST Nov 15, relayed by the consultant (not a page save). Runner 10 has not confirmed the merge; a receiver needs the grant typed in its own session.
holds: Main has been red since 19:25 CST, so the merge tool refuses every merge (#2842, #3479, #3535, #3474, #3514, lanes #3319 and #3550 all wait).

options.gain: Two tests fixed and merges resume at once.
options.how: The merge tool merges claude-settings #3567 at head cf072553bcd6 onto red main, nothing else.
options.label: Yes, #3567 only, on red main
options.lose: One fix-forward exception to the red-main rule; nothing that cannot be undone, since a revert of #3567 is possible.

options.gain: The rule is kept to the letter.
options.how: A revert PR for #3564 is made and merged in place of #3567.
options.label: No, revert #3564 instead
options.lose: The merge tool stops again with 'no required checks', the check removal done at 19:08 is undone in effect, and a revert PR needs a new lint and run first.
